title: MyFreeStyle logo
description: Default header for Nudge, education and relationship emails.
usage: Default header for Nudge / relationship emails. Centered MyFreeStyle lockup on white. Locked layout — edit only image fills and text.

images.notes: Locked. MyFreeStyle lockup baked onto a white 8px-rounded tile (transparent corners), rendered at 2× from the Figma vector.

notes: The logo is baked onto a white 8px-rounded tile, so it is invisible on white and appears as a white logo tile when an inbox darkens the background.
Mobile (≤480px): side padding 48→32 (mobPad32). Vertical padding stays 16px, as in Figma's mobile frame.
